about.groupParagraph1: BFC International & Academy is an international consulting and executive training firm specialized in governance, risk management, strategy and digital transformation across Africa and the Middle East. We support governments, development institutions, financial organizations and private sector leaders in implementing high‑impact transformation programs.
about.groupParagraph2: Operating flawlessly at international standards while maintaining deep-rooted local intelligence, we act as the pivot point for sustainable resilience and expansive growth.
about.heroSubtitle: Driving transformation through governance, innovation and capacity building.
about.missionText: Our mission is to support and guide businesses, governments, and organizations by offering tailored consulting services rooted in local expertise and focused on sustainable growth.
about.nadiaDesc: International expert – Trainer in strategic and organisational management, public policy.
about.reandaParagraph: is a leading global network of accounting and consulting firms. With more than 5,000 professionals and 240 partners across 144 offices in 58 countries, we provide high-quality accounting, audit, tax, and consulting services tailored to our clients' international needs.
